seo.title: Frankencoin frontends — independent ZCHF interfaces
seo.description: Frankencoin is an open protocol. Browse the interfaces for minting, saving and trading ZCHF, each run by its own operator, with source code and hosting details.

header.title: Frankencoin|frontends
header.subtitle: Frankencoin is an open protocol: anyone can build and host an interface to it. The ones listed here are each run by their own operator; one of them is maintained by the Frankencoin Association.

note.title: Before you connect a wallet
note.body: Every frontend talks to the same contracts, but it is the operator who hosts the site. Check that the domain in your address bar matches the one listed here, and prefer an operator you know, for example the frontend maintained by the Frankencoin Association. The protocol does not audit or warrant these interfaces.

addYours.after: and open a pull request to get listed.
